children: Fitch Ratings raises its forecast for U.S. government bond yields by 30bp to 4.8% by end-2026 and expects yields to remain at this level through the end of 2027. "We expect yields to edge down a bit from the 5% rate seen in recent weeks as oil prices fall back, but they will remain well above the levels seen before the U.S.-Iran war," say analysts Brian Coulton and Alex Muscatelli in a report. The Fed delivered its first rate rise in over three years in September and Fitch anticipates a further 25bp increase in December, taking rates to 4.25%. "We expect the Fed to hold rates in 2027, which would leave rates at the end of next year a full 125bp higher than we were forecasting in June," they add. (monica.gupta@wsj.com)
